content.json:
# Lab 4 — Prediction service (staging)
Select the existing Log Analytics workspace. Request rate, errors and latency use `/predict` and `/predict/batch`, excluding probes, and show complete 1-minute bins. Latency is measured inside the service, not at the client.

The feature mean uses valid incoming rows, including requests whose scoring failed. Its trailing 5-minute window is `[point - 5m, point)`, sampled every minute. Batch rows have equal weight to single inputs. Model version ignores the historical time picker and uses only ready/successful signals from the last 5 minutes. Gaps mean no observed data, not a confirmed healthy service. Logs can arrive late.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.description: Choose the existing workspace that receives Lab 4 staging logs.

content.query:
let Start = {TimeRange:start};
let End = {TimeRange:end};
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "itcs355-lab4-staging"
| extend Event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(Event.message) == "request completed"
| where TimeGenerated >= Start and TimeGenerated < End
| where tostring(Event.path) in ("/predict", "/predict/batch")
| summarize Requests = count() by Time = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where Time >= Start and Time + 1m <= End
| project Time, RequestsPerSecond = Requests / 60.0
| order by Time asc
content.title: Prediction request rate — requests/second, complete 1-minute bins
content.noDataMessage: No prediction logs in complete 1-minute bins. This does not prove zero traffic or a healthy service.

content.query:
let Start = {TimeRange:start};
let End = {TimeRange:end};
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "itcs355-lab4-staging"
| extend Event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(Event.message) == "request completed"
| where TimeGenerated >= Start and TimeGenerated < End
| where tostring(Event.path) in ("/predict", "/predict/batch")
| summarize Requests = count(),
    Errors4xx = countif(toint(Event.status) between (400 .. 499)),
    Errors5xx = countif(toint(Event.status) between (500 .. 599))
    by Time = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where Time >= Start and Time + 1m <= End
| project Time, Error4xxPct = 100.0 * Errors4xx / Requests,
    Error5xxPct = 100.0 * Errors5xx / Requests
| order by Time asc
content.title: Prediction errors — 4xx and 5xx (% of requests)
content.noDataMessage: No prediction logs in complete 1-minute bins. This does not prove zero traffic or a healthy service.

content.query:
let Start = {TimeRange:start};
let End = {TimeRange:end};
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "itcs355-lab4-staging"
| extend Event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(Event.message) == "request completed"
| where TimeGenerated >= Start and TimeGenerated < End
| where tostring(Event.path) in ("/predict", "/predict/batch")
| extend LatencyMs = todouble(Event.latency_ms)
| where isnotnull(LatencyMs) and LatencyMs >= 0
| summarize P50Ms = percentile(LatencyMs, 50),
    P95Ms = percentile(LatencyMs, 95), P99Ms = percentile(LatencyMs, 99)
    by Time = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where Time >= Start and Time + 1m <= End
| order by Time asc
content.title: Server request latency — p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
content.noDataMessage: No prediction logs in complete 1-minute bins. This does not prove zero traffic or a healthy service.

content.query:
let Start = {TimeRange:start};
let End = {TimeRange:end};
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "itcs355-lab4-staging"
| extend Event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(Event.message) == "request completed"
| where TimeGenerated >= Start - 5m and TimeGenerated < End
| where tostring(Event.path) in ("/predict", "/predict/batch")
| mv-expand LoadPct = Event.load_pct_values
| extend LoadPct = todouble(LoadPct)
| where isnotnull(LoadPct) and LoadPct between (0.0 .. 100.0)
// One point per minute: each window is [Time - 5m, Time).
// Expand rows before averaging so a batch contributes one sample per input row.
| extend WindowEnds = range(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) + 1m, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) + 5m, 1m)
| mv-expand Time = WindowEnds to typeof(datetime)
| where Time >= Start and Time <= End
| summarize MeanLoadPct = avg(LoadPct), SampleCount = count() by Time
| order by Time asc
content.title: load_pct — trailing 5-minute mean per valid input row
content.noDataMessage: No validated feature samples in these windows. This panel requires load_pct_values telemetry; missing data does not mean no drift.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "itcs355-lab4-staging"
| extend Event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(Event.message) == "request completed"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(5m) and TimeGenerated <= now()
| where toint(Event.status) == 200
| where tostring(Event.path) in ("/predict", "/predict/batch", "/ready")
| extend ModelVersion = tostring(Event.model_version)
| where isnotempty(ModelVersion) and ModelVersion != "unknown"
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ModelVersion
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Model version in staging — observed within the last 5 minutes
content.noDataMessage: No ready or successful prediction signal in the last 5 minutes. Current model version is unconfirmed.
